work_experience.description:
Dec 2018 – July 2023
Mera NN, Telephony and messaging solutions
Project Info:
The solutions allow hospitals and other organizations to perform messaging and calls without traditional telephony. Furthermore, additional features for example WinPDM are included into the service package.
Features:
- WinPDM
- WinBK
Test Engineer
Responsibilities:
- Regression testing
- Performance Testing
- Grey-box testing
- Bugs searching and reporting, verification of results
- Test plan design
- Troubleshooting
- Helping on hot issues and escalations resolving
- Automatic testing scenarios execution and writing basing on Pyton
Technologies: Jira, Spira
QA: Mera side
Project Result: Ongoing Design and Customer Support, Testing strategy for new features was approved by customer and these features were successfully integrated
Mar 2015 – Dec 2018
Mera NN, Cloud base telephony solutions
Project Info:
The solutions allow customers to perform calls without traditional telephony. Furthermore, additional features for example Home Monitoring are included into the service package.
Features:
- VM limits
- VM DropBox
- Push notifications
- Home monitoring
Test Engineer
Responsibilities:
- Sanity testing, regression testing, load testing
- Performance Testing
- Grey-box testing
- Bugs searching and reporting, verification of results
- Test plan design
- Testing lab management
- Troubleshooting
- Helping on hot issues and escalations resolving
Technologies: MS Windows, Bugzilla, Jira
QA: Mera side
Project Result: Ongoing Design and Customer Support, Testing strategy for new features was approved by customer and these features were successfully integrated
June 2014 – Mar 2015
Mera NN, Media Streaming
Project Info:
Contact Center is a context-sensitive, collaborative, voice and multichannel customer experience management solution that allows businesses to manage all types of customer interactions through a unified application.
Features:
- Agent Desktop
- Multichannel
- Multiple call handling
- Offsite Agent solution allows contact center agents to work from any remote location whether that be a home or via a mobile phone
- Granular and customizable real-time and historical reporting for voice and multichannel.
Test Engineer
Responsibilities:
- Sanity testing, regression testing, load testing
- Testing of capacity – how many users calls view Media Stream
- Creating scripts on Linux shell for test automation
- Grey-box testing
- Bugs searching and reporting, verification of results
- Test plan design
- Testing lab management
- Daily scrum meetings, international team
- Sprint planning, providing estimates for testing activities
- Troubleshooting
- Helping on hot issues and escalations resolving
Technologies: IBM Rational ClearQuest, MS Windows
QA: Mera side
Project Result: Ongoing Design and Customer Support, Testing strategy for new features was approved by customer and these features were successfully integrated in GA release
October 2009 – June 2014
Mera NN, IP Client
Project Info:
Communicator provides anywhere access to unified communications capabilities, bringing together voice calling, audio conferencing, corporate directories, and communication logs into one solution, easy-to-use on a desktop or laptop.
Features:
- Intelligent presence
- Instant messaging
- High definition point-to-point video conferencing
- Call control, Contact management
- Support for H.323 and SIP endpoints
Test Engineer
Testing (Test Plan Creation, Lab Setup, Sanity and Regression Testing, Bugfixes Verification)
Responsibilities:
- Sanity testing
- Regression testing
- Software issues investigation and documenting
- Bugfixes verification
- Technical documentation design and maintenance
- Installation of software for new equipment
- Daily meetings with local testing team
Technologies: Jira, Bamboo, ClearQuest
QA: Mera side
Project Result: Ongoing Design and Customer Support, New features were approved by Technical Management

Mera NN, Telephony solutions
Project Info:
The project was related with CS1K system.
Features:
- Automatic installation using JumpStart technology
- Many telephony features
- Support for H.323 and SIP endpoints
Test Engineer
Responsibilities:

- Software issues investigation and documenting

- Technical documentation design and maintenance

- Daily meetings with local testing team
